# engine API — auto-generated by `python -m engine api` (don't edit by hand)

One line per public function: `name(signature)` — first docstring line. Import from `engine.components` unless noted.

## components/badminton.py — Badminton components (first used in "bongkar-ep07-azure-ai-infra").
- `gor(c, x, y, w, h, label, sub=None, ok=0.0, color=None, alpha=1.0)` — Sports hall card (arched roof) = one cloud. ok 0..1 pops a check on the roof.
- `gpu_card(c, x, y, w, h, t, on=1.0, label="GPU", color=None, alpha=1.0, seed=0)` — GPU board: heatsink fins + two fans that spin while on; on 0..1 lights the edge/fans in the signature color.
- `jadwal(c, x, y, w, rows, t, title="JADWAL PELATIH", playhead=None, color=None, row_h=70, alpha=1.0)` — Schedule board. rows: [{label, blocks: [(f0, f1)], color, p (0..1 reveal), struck: (f0, f1) or None}].
- `lapangan(c, x, base_y, w, t, lights=1.0, label=None, color=None, alpha=1.0, lamp_h=260)` — Side-view court on base_y from x to x + w: floor, lines, net at the middle, two overhead lamps.
- `pelontar(c, x, base_y, s, t, fire=0.0, color=None, alpha=1.0, facing=-1)` — Shuttle launcher (height s) on a tripod; fire 0..1 = one shot (recoil). facing -1 shoots to the left.
- `pemain(c, x, base_y, s, t, swing=0.0, facing=1, color=None, alpha=1.0)` — Player (height s) on base_y with a racket; swing 0..1 brings the racket from back to front over the head.
- `rep_dots(c, x, y, n, n_on, color=None, r=8, gap=24, alpha=1.0)` — Row of n repetition dots starting at (x, y); n_on (float) filled, the last one fading in.
- `shuttle(c, x, y, s, rot=0.0, color=None, alpha=1.0)` — Shuttlecock at (x, y) (cork position), size s, pointing along rot (radians; 0 = cork to the right).
- `shuttle_arc(x0, y0, x1, y1, peak, u)` — (x, y, angle) at u 0..1 on a parabola from (x0, y0) to (x1, y1) rising `peak` px above the higher end.

## components/fx.py — Physical-motion upgrades (opt-in, 2026-10-08): springs, landings, contact shadows, ghost trails.
- `contact_shadow(c, cx, base_y, w, lift=0.0, alpha=1.0)` — Soft ellipse shadow on the floor under an object of width w; lift (px above the floor) shrinks + fades it.
- `ghost_trail(c, t, draw_at, n=None, span=None, alpha=0.45)` — Draw draw_at(c, tt) at t plus n fading ghosts reaching `span` seconds back (frame = f(t), so it's exact).
- `land(t, t_land, dur=None)` — Squash amount after a landing at t_land: +1 = squashed flat … −0.4 = stretched rebound … 0 = rest.
- `settle(t, t0, dur=None)` — Spring progress 0 → ~1.06 → 1 starting at t0 (use as a scale for small pops, or as a camera ease).
- `squash(c, cx, base_y, amount)` — Non-uniform scale anchored at the object's foot (cx, base_y): amount > 0 = wider & shorter.

- `mask_word(c, t, t_in, t_out, x, base, word, font, size, color, ls=0.0, d_in=None, exit="mask")` — One word that rises from behind its own baseline mask (and leaves up through it, or dims).
- `motion_blur(speed, k=None)` — Blur (px) for something moving at `speed` px/s — 0 at rest, capped (tk.M['mblur_*']).

## components/migrate.py — Data-migration explainer components (first used in Bongkar Arsitektur EP02).
- `bookshelf(c, x, y, w, h, t, rows=4, seed=3, pulled=None, changed=None, falling=None, ghost=0.0, diff=None, diff_p=0.0)` — pulled: {i: p} slides book i up/out · changed: {i: p} flashes a new color · falling: (i, p) drops a book.
- `cutover_switch(c, t, x, y, w, h, p_flip=0.0, p_rollback=0.0, flow=1.0)` — App on top; fork to legacy (left) and Alibaba Cloud (right). Lever flips left→right with p_flip.
- `keycap(c, cx, cy, label, press=0.0, size=220, sub="")` — 3D-ish key: top face + darker base; press 0..1 pushes it down (pulse it for a tap).
- `padlock(c, cx, cy, s, p_open=0.0, color=None)` — Padlock; shackle lifts and swings open with p_open.
- `series_bumper(c, t, t0, t1, ep, sub, color, title=("BONGKAR", "ARSITEKTUR"))` — Full-bleed color panel that wipes up at t0, holds, wipes out ending at t1 (draw at z >= 100).
- `shelf_books(x, y, w, h, rows=4, seed=3)` — Deterministic book layout → list of (x, y, bw, bh, color_index).
- `sync_pipe(c, t, src, dst, p_pipe=1.0, p_full=0.0, p_inc=0.0, open_badge=0.0, labels=("full copy", "incremental sync"))` — src/dst = node dicts for arch_node (x, y, w, h, kind, label, a). Two lanes between them:
- `twin_table(c, x, y, w, rows, row_h=96, titles=("LEGACY", "ALIBABA CLOUD"))` — rows: [dict(name, count, h_left, h_right, slide, lock, bad=None|index, fix=0..1)].

## components/motion.py — Shared motion recipes: how things enter, leave, and type.
- `appear(c, t, t_in, t_out, bbox, draw, rise=None, scale=None, blur=None, d_in=None, d_out=None, pad=70, enter="up", exit="up", rot=0.0)` — Element entrance/exit with blur.
- `bezier_partial(c, p0, p1, p2, p3, p, steps=48)` — Path of the first p (0..1) of a cubic bezier, as a polyline.
- `count(t, t0, dur, v0, v1)` — Eased count-up value.
- `fade(c, t, t_in, t_out, draw, d_in=0.4, d_out=0.3)` — Plain opacity in/out (for small things: labels, tags).
- `fmt_id(v, decimals=0)` — Indonesian number format: 2951 → '2.951', 44.4 → '44,4'.
- `stagger(i, step=None)` — 
- `type_cues(text, t0, cps=None, name="key", gain=0.5)` — SFX cues for each typed character (spaces are skipped).
- `type_end(text, t0, cps=None)` — 
- `typed(text, t, t0, cps=None)` — Typewriter state: (full_chars_text, partial_char, partial_alpha, done).
- `wobble(t, seed=0, amp=1.0, hz=0.3)` — Tiny deterministic idle float (use 2-4 px) so resting cards feel alive.

## components/payday.py — Payday / detective components (first used in "kenapa-bank-down-gajian").
- `cashier(c, cx, cy, s, t, busy=1.0, seed=0, color=None, alpha=1.0)` — Checkout counter seen from above, centered on (cx, cy), width s: belt with items moving, register, cashier.
- `ledger(c, cx, cy, s, t, filled=1.0, hot=0.0, writing=0.0, title="BUKU KAS", color=None, alpha=1.0)` — Open ledger book seen from above, centered on (cx, cy), width s. Cover in the signature color, two ruled pages.
- `paper_sheet(c, x, y, w, h, rows=6, filled=1.0, alpha=1.0, torn=True, dashed=False, color=None)` — One ledger sheet: torn top edge, ruled lines, mono 'entries' filled up to `filled` (0..1).
- `pin(c, x, y, r=13, color=None)` — Push pin seen from above: colored head + highlight.
- `queue_dots(c, pts, t, n=6, speed=0.22, jam=0.0, r=9, seed=0, color=None, alpha=1.0)` — People walking along polyline pts toward its end. jam 0..1: they slow down and bunch up near the end.
- `red_string(c, pts, p, sag=46, color=None, width=3)` — Detective string through the pins, sagging between them; p 0..1 draws it left→right.
- `suspect_card(c, x, y, w, h, num, name, label, icon=None, reveal=1.0, tear=0.0, rot=0.0, focus=0.0, dim=0.0, color=None)` — Polaroid-style suspect card pinned at its top center.
- `tear_calendar(c, x, y, w, h, t, t0, start=21, end=25, step=0.2, month="OKTOBER", color=None, circle_p=0.0, sub="", sub_p=0.0)` — Desk tear-off calendar: color header band with the month, two rings, page with the date.
- `torn_flight(p, w, h)` — (dx, dy, rot, alpha) of a sheet torn off and falling away, p 0..1 (gravity: dy ~ p²).

## components/pill.py — Pills, chips, tags, selection boxes — the small UI vocabulary.
- `chip(c, x, y, label, dot, alpha=1.0, h=40)` — Context chip ('● CLAUDE.md') — white pill, colored dot. Returns width.
- `select_box(c, t, t0, x, y, w, h, label=None, t_out=None, pad=10)` — Design-tool selection: blue frame + square handles + size label. Pops in at t0.
- `size_label(c, cx, y, text, alpha=1.0)` — Tiny blue pill with white mono text, centered at cx ('522 × 148').
- `strike(c, t, t0, x1, x2, y, width=7, dur=0.5, alpha=1.0)` — Blue strike-through drawn left→right.
- `tag(c, x, y, label, color=None, alpha=1.0, align="l", h=36)` — Soft blue tag ('ukuran video'). align='r' puts its right edge at x. Returns width.
- `word_pill(c, x, y, word, color, size=104, alpha=1.0, pad_x=34, pad_y=18)` — Big colored pill with white display text ('keyframe.' / 'kode.'). Returns (w, h).

## components/recap.py — Dark-section components: recap diagram (steps → rules) and the outro CTA.
- `connector(c, x1, y1, x2, y2, p, color=None, width=2.5)` — S-curve from (x1,y1) to (x2,y2), drawn to fraction p.
- `contact_pill(c, cx, y, text, sub="", color=None, icon="globe", w=None, h=64, alpha=1.0)` — Dark pill with icon + bold text + tiny mono sub-label ('mumeyong.dev  SITUS').
- `follow_button(c, cx, y, t, t_click, w=300, h=72)` — '+ Follow' (blue) → pressed at t_click → '✓ Following' (dark).
- `rule_box(c, x, y, w, idx, label, color, fill=0.0, h=62)` — Right-column rule slot. fill 0 = dashed empty slot, 1 = filled with numbered label.
- `segments(c, x, y, n, k, w=34, gap=10, h=4)` — '━━ ━━ ── ── ──  02 / 05' progress.
- `step_row(c, x, y, w, num, label, active=0.0, h=62)` — Left-column chapter row ('01 ATURAN'). active 0..1 brightens it.

## components/relay.py — Payment-relay components (first used in "qris-dua-detik").
- `es_teh(c, cx, base_y, s, t=0.0, alpha=1.0)` — Plastic cup of iced tea (height s) standing on base_y: amber tea, ice cubes, straw, condensation drops.
- `mesh_hub(c, cx, cy, r, t, n=6, p_mesh=1.0, p_hub=0.0, color=None, hub_label="switching", node_label="bank")` — n bank nodes on a circle. p_mesh draws every node-to-node line (the mess); p_hub fades the mesh out and
- `qr_code(c, x, y, s, seed=1, color=None, alpha=1.0, n=25, reveal=1.0)` — Square QR-looking code at (x, y), size s: 3 finder patterns + hash-seeded modules. reveal 0..1 fills top→bottom.
- `qris_stand(c, cx, base_y, s, seed=1, color=None, name="Warung Es Teh", alpha=1.0)` — Acrylic QR standee on a counter: card (width s) with a header band, merchant name and the QR, on a foot.
- `relay_track(c, x, y, w, h, xs, labels, t, baton_x=None, lit=(), active=None, back=0.0, slow=0.0, color=None, draw=1.0, dim=())` — Horizontal running track (band x, y, w, h) with runner tokens at xs (numbered), labels under them.
- `slowmo_badge(c, x, y, t, speed="0,1×", tc="", frozen=0.0, alpha=1.0, align="r")` — Replay badge: '▶ 0,1×' (or '❚❚ TAHAN' when frozen) + a mono timecode. (x, y) = its right (or left) top.

## components/tickets.py — Ticket-war / queue components (first used in "war-tiket-crash").
- `big_clock(c, x, y, text, size, prev=None, jump=1.0, color=None, accent_from=None, align="l")` — Digital clock text 'HH:MM:SS' with baseline y. Characters that differ from `prev` drop in from above
- `dispenser(c, cx, y, s, t, serving="", serving_prev=None, jump=1.0, called=0.0, press=0.0, color=None)` — Queue-number machine (kantor pos), top center (cx, y), width s, height ≈ 1.45 s.
- `loket(c, x, y, w, h, t, full=0.0, label="", seed=0, color=None, alpha=1.0, busy=1.0)` — Counter window: frame, glass with a clerk, lamp on top (green → red when full), label plate, slip slot.
- `print_slip(c, x, y, w, h, p, lines, color=None, rot=0.0, slot=True)` — Slip feeding out of a slot whose top edge is at (x, y), width w; full length h at p=1.
- `refresh_icon(c, x, y, s, color, rot=0.0, alpha=1.0, width=None)` — ↻ : open circular arrow, centered (x, y), diameter s.
- `refresh_storm(c, cx, cy, rx, ry, t, n=24, amount=1.0, speed=0.25, size=(26, 54), seed=1, color=None, alpha=1.0, inward=0.0)` — ↻ icons swirling on an elliptical band around (cx, cy). amount 0..1 = share of the n icons present

## components/transit.py — Commuter-line (KRL) components (first used in "roadmap-cloud-engineer").
- `cert_card(c, x, y, w, h, title, sub="", color=None, alpha=1.0, rot=0.0, label="SERTIFIKAT")` — Certificate drawn as a perforated ticket: notches, stub with a seal, mono label, title.
- `route_strip(c, x, ys, t, p_draw=1.0, reach=0.0, lit=(), names=(), subs=(), color=None, label_a=1.0, dead=(), active=None, width=14)` — Vertical line at x through stations at ys (top→bottom).
- `save_button(c, cx, y, t, t_click, w=300, h=72, color=None)` — 'Save' (outlined bookmark) → pressed at t_click → 'Tersimpan' with a filled bookmark. color: fill when saved.
- `station_dots(c, x0, x1, y, n, lit, color=None, r=14)` — Compact horizontal route (recap bookend): n stations between x0 and x1, lit 0..1 each.
- `train(c, cx, cy, s, color=None, alpha=1.0, ghost=False, t=0.0)` — Commuter train seen from the front, centered (cx, cy), height s. ghost = dashed outline only.

## components/widgets.py — Content widgets: stat tiles, waveform, REC bar, filmstrip, phone, comment bubble, cursor.
- `Cursor(keys, clicks=(), show=None, hide=None)` — Mouse pointer moving through keyframes [(t, x, y)], clicking at times in `clicks`.
  - `.cues(self)` — 
  - `.draw(self, c, t)` — 
  - `.pos(self, t)` — 
- `big_number(c, x, y, value, t, t0, decimals=1, suffix=" s", caption="", sub="", dur=1.0)` — Free-standing big number with mono caption above ('WAKTU VIDEO / 44,4 s / frame 2.663').
- `comment(c, x, y, w, user, text, initial=None, highlight=None)` — TikTok 'Balas komentar' bubble with tail. text may contain \n. highlight = substring to mark.
- `filmstrip(c, x, y, w, h, images, t, head=None, head_label=None, colors=None)` — Row of thumbnails in a card with an optional blue playhead at fraction `head`.
- `phone(c, x, y, w, h, image=None, draw_screen=None, dark=True)` — Phone mockup. Either an image path or draw_screen(c, sx, sy, sw, sh).
- `rec_bar(c, x, y, w, t, t0, h=84)` — Recording pill: red mic button, blinking REC, running timer, live red bars.
- `stat(c, x, y, w, h, value, label, t, t0, decimals=0, suffix="", dur=1.2, highlight=False)` — Count-up stat card ('2.951' / 'baris kode'). Indonesian number format.
- `waveform(c, x, y, w, h, t, t0, dur, colors=None, bar=5, gap=3, seed=1, segments=None, env=None)` — Waveform drawn left→right from t0 over dur. y is the center line.
